Order the sides of the triangle $△ABC$ above from the shortest to the longest.
question.worked_solution:
First, let's find the missing angle $B.$ Since the interior angles of a triangle sum to ${180}^{∘},$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}m∠A+m∠B+m∠C & ={180}^{∘} \\ {40}^{∘}+m∠B+{95}^{∘} & ={180}^{∘} \\ m∠B & ={180}^{∘}-{135}^{∘} \\ m∠B & ={45}^{∘}.\end{aligned}
$$

Since $∠C$ is the largest angle, its opposite side $\overset{―}{AB}$ must be the longest side of the triangle. 

Since $∠A$ is the smallest angle, its opposite side $\overset{―}{BC}$ is the shortest side of the triangle.

So, we have

$$
BC<AC<AB
$$

and therefore the required order is

$$
\overset{―}{BC},\,\overset{―}{AC},\,\overset{―}{AB}.
$$
